name: Double Cork Charge (Combat)
body:
Your aerial tricks on ice skates and skis confound your enemies.

Prerequisite(s): Skill Focus (Acrobatics), Snow Bum.

Benefit(s): When you succeed on an Acrobatics check to charge an opponent while ice skating or skiing, you deny your target his Dexterity bonus to AC and ignore the –2 penalty to AC imposed by charging if your Acrobatics check equals or exceeds your target’s CMD.
